title: Infinite list
name: loadMore
english: Load the next page of items when the person reaches the end of the list, one page at a time.

inputs.name: load
inputs.type: (cursor: string | number | null) => Promise<{items: T[], nextCursor: string | number | null}>
inputs.sentence: What loads the page after a cursor.

outputs.name: items
outputs.sentence: Every loaded item, page after page.

outputs.name: hasNextPage
outputs.sentence: Whether there is more to load.

outputs.name: isFetchingNextPage
outputs.sentence: Whether the next page is loading now.

events.sentence: The first page starts loading, or the list is refreshed.

wraps.concept: useInfiniteQuery: pages, getNextPageParam, hasNextPage, fetchNextPage, isFetchingNextPage
wraps.adapter: The load input is the query function given the page param; each page's nextCursor is what getNextPageParam answers.

signals.sentence: This function appends the next page of items by hand.
